evals.prompt: /implement-feature Add a rate limiter for the /api/upload endpoint, single-instance deployment
assertions: Searches the codebase for an existing rate-limiting utility or middleware before writing new code
Does not introduce a RateLimiter interface or factory for a single concrete implementation
Adds input validation and returns an appropriate error response for invalid input
If the implementation is in-memory and single-instance only, leaves a LEAN-DEBT marker naming the upgrade trigger (e.g. running more than one replica)
The plan produced in Phase 2 states why each proposed component needs to exist before implementation begins

evals.prompt: /implement-feature Add a CSV export button to the reports page
assertions: Reuses an existing export, download, or serialization utility already present in the codebase rather than writing a new CSV serializer from scratch
Does not add configurable export-format options that were not requested
Validates the dataset before exporting and handles the empty-data case
The subagent report notes any LEAN-DEBT shortcuts taken

evals.prompt: /implement-feature Add email verification to user signup
assertions: Validates email format and handles token-expiration and invalid-token error paths
Does not build a generic pluggable notification-provider abstraction for a single email provider
Reuses an existing mail-sending utility if one already exists in the codebase
The plan documents why each new component (token generator, verification endpoint, email template) needs to exist
